articles.title: Wall Street gets new crypto rival after Texas bank completes regulatory pivot
articles.snippet: By establishing a national charter under the executive branch, United Texas Bank said it intends to enable AI-driven payment rails to intercept global digital dollar volumes.

articles.title: Elon Musk could become a top 5 corporate bitcoin holder if Tesla and SpaceX merge
articles.snippet: CNBC reported Tuesday that Musk is discussing a merger between Tesla and SpaceX that would tie his tech empire closer together and instantly create the world’s fifth-largest corporate bitcoin treasury, worth $3.3 billion.

articles.title: Robinhood is letting AI trade for you so you don't have to keep checking the markets
articles.snippet: Robinhood is bringing hedge fund-style automation to everyday investors by letting AI agents build portfolios, execute stock trades, and even go shopping using virtual credit cards.

articles.title: Crypto’s biggest exchanges back push for token disclosure standards as industry courts institutional capital
articles.snippet: More than 40 crypto firms, including rival exchanges Coinbase and Kraken, are backing a Blockworks-led framework aimed at bringing stock market-style disclosures to token markets.

articles.title: Live markets: bitcoin sentiment in 'absolute gutter' as price slips below $75,000
articles.snippet: Memory chip stocks are attracting capital and attention, with crypto markets settling into apathy.
